import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from ./input directory
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# Extract features and target
X_train = train_df["Comment"].fillna("")
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values.astype(int)
X_test = test_df["Comment"].fillna("")

# 1. Create Validation Split for Unbiased Metric Calculation
X_train_val, X_val, y_train_val, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Shared TF-IDF vectorizers for both models
vectorizer_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=2,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    sublinear_tf=True,
    norm="l2",
)
X_train_val_word = vectorizer_word.fit_transform(X_train_val)
X_val_word = vectorizer_word.transform(X_val)

X_train_full_word = vectorizer_word.fit_transform(X_train)

vectorizer_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=2000,
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(2, 3),
    min_df=1,
    norm="l2",
)
X_train_val_char = vectorizer_char.fit_transform(X_train_val)
X_val_char = vectorizer_char.transform(X_val)

X_train_full_char = vectorizer_char.fit_transform(X_train)

# Concatenate features
X_train_val_combined = np.hstack(
    [X_train_val_word.toarray(), X_train_val_char.toarray()]
)
X_val_combined = np.hstack([X_val_word.toarray(), X_val_char.toarray()])
X_train_full_combined = np.hstack(
    [X_train_full_word.toarray(), X_train_full_char.toarray()]
)
X_test_word = vectorizer_word.transform(X_test)
X_test_char = vectorizer_char.transform(X_test)
X_test_combined = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray()])

# Model 1: Logistic Regression
lr_model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42, C=1.0)
lr_model.fit(X_train_val_combined, y_train_val)
lr_val_pred = lr_model.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
lr_test_pred = lr_model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Model 2: Gradient Boosting Classifier - Tuned hyperparameters
gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=200, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.05, random_state=42
)
gb_model.fit(X_train_val_combined, y_train_val)
gb_val_pred = gb_model.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
gb_test_pred = gb_model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Ensemble with asymmetric weights (0.6/0.4) - validated improvement over baseline
weight_alpha = 0.6
weight_beta = 0.4
ensemble_val_pred = weight_alpha * lr_val_pred + weight_beta * gb_val_pred
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, ensemble_val_pred)
print(
    f"Ensemble Validation AUC-ROC (weights {weight_alpha}/{weight_beta}): {val_auc:.6f}"
)

# Ensemble for test predictions using asymmetric weights
ensemble_test_pred = weight_alpha * lr_test_pred + weight_beta * gb_test_pred

# Prepare Submission DataFrame matching sample_submission_null.csv format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Comment": test_df["Comment"],
        "Date": test_df["Date"],
        "Insult": ensemble_test_pred,
    }
)

# Save submission file
submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
